## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: how much of the Domain Lens block to cut from the 12 agent files
- **Chosen**: delete only the ordering-mandate sentence ('Before analyzing, apply this reasoning sequence:') in the 10 files that carry it; every '## Domain Lens' heading and all numbered steps stay
- **Rejected**: the prior session's scoping (scratchpad phase-b-measurements.md): heading + mandate sentence in 10 files plus heading-only in facilitator/steward, with consumer rewrites to match
- **Why rejected**: new evidence the scoping note did not have — the heading is a named referent in live consumers: .claude/commands/review.md line ~450 twice ('Apply your Domain Lens before beginning analysis'), .claude/agents/facilitator.md:58, plus ADR-0010, docs/FRAMEWORK_SPECIFICATION.md, docs/AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md and PHILOSOPHY.md describe the lens by name. Deleting the referent of a just-stabilized dispatch prompt to save ~12 more lines re-creates the dangling-reference class TestProseReferencesResolve exists for
- **Files**: .claude/agents/architecture-consultant.md, .claude/agents/docs-knowledge.md, .claude/agents/educator.md, .claude/agents/history-analyst.md, .claude/agents/independent-perspective.md, .claude/agents/performance-analyst.md, .claude/agents/project-analyst.md, .claude/agents/qa-specialist.md, .claude/agents/security-specialist.md, .claude/agents/ux-evaluator.md
- **Falsifier**: no honest token nameable - the rejected option is a larger DELETION plus a consumer rewrite whose replacement wording was never drafted, and a diff's added lines cannot witness a non-deletion; the checkable trace is the inverse (all 12 '## Domain Lens' headings survive in the post-cut tree)

## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: how to remove the Persona Bias Safeguard surface (37 lines, 10 agent files)
- **Chosen**: delete all 10 blocks wholesale, no replacement anywhere
- **Rejected**: condense the 10 blocks into one shared persona-bias rule in a common surface (CLAUDE.md or a skill) so the value survives in fewer lines
- **Why rejected**: the blocks are generic self-check prose with zero measured couplings (grep 'Persona Bias' outside .claude/agents/ returns 0 hits, exit 1) and no thresholds; a condensed shared copy would preserve model-facing scaffolding in a new location, which is the surface being ablated, not a consumer of it
- **Files**: .claude/agents/architecture-consultant.md, .claude/agents/docs-knowledge.md, .claude/agents/educator.md, .claude/agents/independent-perspective.md, .claude/agents/performance-analyst.md, .claude/agents/project-analyst.md, .claude/agents/qa-specialist.md, .claude/agents/security-specialist.md, .claude/agents/steward.md, .claude/agents/ux-evaluator.md
- **Falsifier**: Persona Bias

## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: what to do with the deprecated /distribute alias (.claude/commands/distribute.md, 21 physical / 17 non-blank lines - both circulating figures were the same file counted differently)
- **Chosen**: delete the file and remove its KNOWN_STALE_CITATIONS entry in tests/test_constitution_consistency.py (the registry test fails on registered-but-missing paths by design, line ~1453). CLAUDE.md's 'Never set by /distribute' sentence is left untouched: it sits inside the developer-owned Autonomous Execution Authorization block, remains literally true, and is flagged to the developer instead
- **Rejected**: keep a rewritten one-line deprecation stub so /distribute still resolves for muscle memory
- **Why rejected**: measured 0/4 derived-project installs, self-labelled DEPRECATED since ADR-0021, zero live invokers (stage_branch.py's docstring cites it but the live caller is apply-framework.md:179); a stub is instruction surface that exists to say it should not exist
- **Files**: .claude/commands/distribute.md, tests/test_constitution_consistency.py
- **Falsifier**: DEPRECATED ALIAS

## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: what to do with the grill-yourself skill (.claude/skills/grill-yourself/SKILL.md, 99 lines)
- **Chosen**: delete the skill directory
- **Rejected**: fold its distinctive content (the model ghost-writes the hard questions and answers them, human only renders verdicts) into the sibling grill-me skill instead of deleting outright
- **Why rejected**: measured 0/4 derived installs against grill-me's 3/4 with zero template-local live consumers (the only references are the file itself, one brainstorm, one retired proposal); the hub standard says derived-project usage is the denominator, and six-plus weeks of zero is the answer. grill-me already covers the interview need; merging would grow the surviving skill to preserve a capability nobody has invoked
- **Files**: .claude/skills/grill-yourself/SKILL.md
- **Falsifier**: grill-yourself

## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: whether the grill-yourself deletion (record 4 of this discussion) survives blind review
- **Chosen**: REVERSED - the skill is restored from HEAD unchanged; the deletion does not ship
- **Rejected**: shipping the deletion as recorded
- **Why rejected**: the blind critic refuted record 4's warrant with tree evidence the builder did not check: (1) the 0/4 derived-install measurement is CONFOUNDED - grill-yourself was created 2026-07-02 (4af9e75) and the last propagation event in the tree is 2026-06-14 (21288c0), so its zero was guaranteed by calendar order, and the 3/4 comparator grill-me predates the window; (2) no instrument records skill invocation at all (grep skill scripts/telemetry/*.py = no output), so the surface was ablated before anything could observe it - the exact ADR-0032 inversion this effort exists to prevent; (3) the tree's only prior disposition (PROPOSAL-20260806-ac7-dispositions.md:444) classifies it HUMAN-FACING / RESTORE, and ADR-0031 Decision 5 removes human-facing surfaces from the deletion candidate set; (4) its measurement-design taxonomy (Goodhart, checker ceiling, ground truth, leakage...) exists on no other live surface. Record 4 was the tidy-but-false story the mechanism warns about, and the review layer caught it where the mechanical checker (correctly, per its own caveat) could not
- **Files**: .claude/skills/grill-yourself/SKILL.md
- **Falsifier**: no token nameable - the rejected option is the deletion itself; the checkable trace is the file's presence at HEAD state in the committed tree

## Path Not Taken
- **Decision**: whether the ordering-mandate cut covers facilitator.md and steward.md, whose Domain Lens blocks open with structurally similar sentences (Before orchestrating any workflow: / Before evaluating any proposed framework change:)
- **Chosen**: exempt both - cut only the 10 files carrying the generic sentence Before analyzing, apply this reasoning sequence:
- **Rejected**: widening the cut to all 12 for a clean ablation treatment group
- **Why rejected**: the two exempted sentences bind their numbered steps to a WORKFLOW PHASE (orchestration setup, framework-evolution gating) rather than instructing the model to think in order; deleting them would leave those two lists unanchored to when they apply. The blind critic flagged the exemption as unrecorded (F5) - this record closes that gap rather than widening a deletion on the last slice of the session
- **Files**: .claude/agents/facilitator.md, .claude/agents/steward.md
- **Falsifier**: Before orchestrating any workflow
